title: 介词
goal: 能根据时间、空间关系和固定搭配选择介词。

points.label: 根据时间与空间关系选择介词

body.p: 介词和后面的名词、代词或动名词组成介词短语。用哪个介词，有时看时间或空间关系，有时由前面的动词或形容词决定。

body.box: The meeting begins at noon. / The result depends on careful planning.

body.p: at 表示时刻，depend on 是固定搭配。介词后面接动词时，用动名词，如 interested in learning。

cards.title: 时间介词
rows: The exhibition stays open until Friday.

cards.title: 空间介词
rows: The chairs are in the room.
The box is on the shelf.
The bag is under the table.
A clock hangs above the door.
The bin is between the desks.
A garden lies behind the house.
The hotel is near the station.

cards.title: 动词搭配
rows: The result depends on the weather.

cards.title: 形容词搭配
rows: Li is responsible for the tickets.
He is proud of the team.
The child is afraid of dogs.
This map is different from mine.
We are familiar with the route.

items.stem: The form may arrive any time up to and including Friday. Use a preposition of deadline: Return it _____ Friday.
The shop remains open continuously and closes at six. It stays open _____ six.
items.why: until 和 till 表示持续到六点。

items.stem: The success of the trip depends _____ the weather.
Mei is responsible _____ collecting the tickets.
items.why: be responsible for 表示负责，介词后用动名词。

items.stem: The children are interested _____ making paper models.
items.why: be interested in 表示对某事感兴趣。

items.stem: The poster is attached to the surface of the wall. It is _____ the wall.

groups.text: A community center planned a workshop on repairing clothes. The workshop was scheduled for a Saturday afternoon, and several volunteers offered to help. Participants were asked to arrive [1] two o'clock, when the doors would open. The organizers placed boxes of thread and buttons [2] a shelf inside the room. Each box carried a label so that visitors could find its contents. One volunteer was responsible [3] welcoming the visitors and checking their names. Another was good [4] sewing and prepared a demonstration using a torn pocket. Participants first watched the demonstration and then worked on clothes they had brought from home. The teacher showed how to choose a suitable needle and secure the thread. The room remained open [5] five, when the workshop ended and everyone helped put the tools away. Before leaving, the visitors wrote down the methods they had learned. Some also asked whether the center could hold another workshop. The organizers collected these suggestions in a folder and planned to discuss them at their next meeting. The folder would help them decide what materials to prepare in the future.

items.stem: [1] Participants were asked to arrive _____ exactly two o'clock.
[2] The organizers placed boxes on the surface of a shelf. The boxes were _____ the shelf.
items.why: on 表示在架子表面上。

items.stem: [3] One volunteer was responsible _____ welcoming the visitors.
items.why: be responsible for 表示负责。
be good at 表示擅长。

items.stem: [5] The room stayed open continuously and closed at five. It remained open _____ five.
items.why: until 或 till 表示持续到结束时刻。

groups.text: A class planned a visit to a local weather station. Before the trip, the teacher gave each student a map and a list of questions. The group agreed to meet [1] Monday, the day of the visit. Students also had to return their signed forms no later than Friday, so the teacher asked for the forms [2] Friday. At the station, a guide explained how instruments measure wind and rainfall. The students were interested [3] learning how the readings were recorded. The guide showed them a chart and invited them to compare results from different days. The readings depend [4] the conditions at the time, so the guide explained the date beside each entry. After the tour, the class waited [5] the bus at the station gate. While waiting, the students discussed which instrument they would like to learn more about. Back at school, they organized their notes and drew pictures of the equipment. The teacher kept the questions and answers together in a class folder, which would be used during a later classroom discussion of the station's weather records.

items.stem: [1] The group agreed to meet _____ Monday.
[2] The forms could arrive any time up to and including Friday. Use a preposition of deadline: The teacher asked for them _____ Friday.
items.why: by 表示不晚于截止时间。

items.stem: [3] The students were interested _____ learning about the readings.
items.why: be interested in 是固定搭配。

items.stem: [4] The readings depend _____ the conditions at the time.
[5] After the tour, the class waited _____ the bus to arrive.
